x-q4t.semantics: Structural shapes include required planned capabilities. Shape validity does not promise that a model, tool or state executor is available. Check native planning and runtime capabilities; pending capabilities remain required implementation tasks.
adaptations: SDK-added output_text is optional on wire

Files multipart uses binary file and bracket-encoded expires_after fields; explicit native capacity and storage quotas remain separate
Files HTTP list uses string first_id/last_id; native empty pages use empty strings and has_more=false, not nullable cursors from other list resources
official HTTP examples use usage:null for active/cancelled responses; completed/incomplete require actual usage
native store echo and native response error codes

optional q4t_moderation_usage discloses bounded auxiliary classifier tokens separately from business usage

exact integer and bounded native options

wire_references.contract: Request and breakpoint TTL 30m/12h; exact eligible boundaries; overlapping read/write token accounting
Optional client-scoped short-lived hashes; unavailable never fails generation; terminal SSE carries comparison
Cancelled resource can have usage:null; no fabricated zero usage
Standalone compact preserves user messages and returns the canonical next input window with encrypted compaction state
response.created example has usage:null; successful final usage includes cache_write_tokens

x-q4t.cancelled_stream: Resource is cancelled; original events end without fabricated response.cancelled/completed or Chat DONE.
x-q4t.query: Closed route-specific fields; repeated include[] is an array; exact decimal integers and true/false booleans.
